countertop_cooker.descriptor: round countertop cooker with a lid

field_tiers.doc: Fields this domain writes onto other domains' entities (pots, mugs, dishes, food, probes): a liquid's temperature needs a thermometer; a look at food shows its colour and texture, never the colour of the juices (pierce or cut it: check_doneness fork) or its firmness (press it); bookkeeping is hidden.

cooking_appliance.doc: Root of large kitchen appliances (ranges, ovens, fridges, dishwashers, hoods, grills). ac_kind selects the behaviour.

view.doc: The rating plate (watts, volts) is small print inside a door or on the back; the timer line of a display uses the display's own 10 mm digits.
The rating plate is small print on the underside or back; the timer line of a display uses the display's own 10 mm digits.

range_gas.doc: Freestanding 76 cm gas range: 4 sealed burners (3.5/2.6/2.0/1.4 kW) and an oven below.

range_electric.doc: Freestanding 76 cm electric coil range (2 x 2.6 kW + 2 x 1.5 kW coils).

range_radiant.doc: Glass-ceramic radiant range with residual-heat indicators.

range_induction.doc: Induction range: zones heat only ferromagnetic cookware (pan detection, boost).

cooktop_gas.doc: Built-in gas cooktop set into a counter.

cooktop_induction.doc: Built-in induction hob set into a counter.

burner.doc: One cooktop burner/zone (part of a range). settings.heat is the knob; burner holds kind, rating, ignition state.

range_oven.doc: Oven cavity (70 L) of a range: bake 3.0 kW, broil 3.6 kW, 6 rack positions, light, clock, timer, self-clean.

view.doc: The cavity shows through the door window only while the oven light is on (transparent); the body itself is an opaque box. A broken oven's hand-written OUT OF ORDER tag has letters about 2 cm high; the timer line of the display uses the same 10 mm digits as the clock.

wall_oven.doc: Built-in wall oven at chest height.

oven_rack.doc: Removable chrome oven rack (shelf index = rack position).

range_hood.doc: Ducted range hood: fan low/medium/high/boost = 0.07/0.12/0.19/0.24 m3/s (150-500 cfm), light, grease filter.

hood_filter.doc: Washable aluminum mesh grease filter of a range hood.

refrigerator.doc: Bottom-freezer refrigerator (fridge compartment ~3.5 C). Door alarm after 2 min open; door bins, crispers, gasket and the freezer drawer are child parts (the freezer drawer is a part with its own door, air model and z_m).

top_freezer_refrigerator.doc: Top-freezer refrigerator; the freezer compartment is a part of the refrigerator (z_m 1.3) with its own door.

freezer_drawer.doc: Freezer compartment/drawer of a refrigerator (-18 C): a part of its refrigerator (relation part, z_m = its floor height in the cabinet), powered through it (power_from).

view.doc: The bottom freezer drawer slides out and is looked into from above (the top-freezer compartment of the same type keeps its front door).

upright_freezer.doc: Upright manual-defrost freezer (frost builds on the shelves/evaporator plates).

chest_freezer.doc: Chest freezer (manual defrost, drain plug, hinged lid).

fridge_door_bin.doc: Removable refrigerator door bin (fridge_zone door). Items deeper than the bin protrude and stop the door sealing. Plastic, not a heat source: contents sit in the compartment air.

view.doc: Door bins are open trays looked into from above.

crisper_drawer.doc: Refrigerator crisper drawer with a humidity slider. Plastic, not a heat source: contents sit in the compartment air.

view.doc: A crisper slides out and is looked into from above.

door_gasket.doc: Magnetic/rubber door seal of a fridge, freezer or dishwasher. settings.seated false = folded/out of its channel (leaks).

dishwasher.doc: Built-in 60 cm dishwasher (12 place settings): racks, utensil basket, detergent cup, rinse-aid reservoir, filter, sump and gasket are parts. Programs normal/heavy/eco/quick/rinse/sanitize.

dishwasher_drawer.doc: Single-drawer dishwasher (6 place settings, one rack + basket).

dishwasher_rack_bottom.doc: Lower dishwasher rack: tines for 12 plates, room for 2 large pots/pans/sheets at the sides/back; the heating element is below it.

view.doc: A pulled-out rack is seen from above, like a basket.

dishwasher_rack_top.doc: Upper dishwasher rack: cups, mugs, glasses, small bowls and plastics (away from the heating element).

view.doc: A pulled-out rack is seen from above, like a basket.

dishwasher_utensil_basket.doc: Cutlery basket with 6 compartments (sits in the bottom rack door side).

view.doc: Cutlery stands in it handle up or down: seen from above.

detergent_cup.doc: Detergent dispenser cup on the inside of the dishwasher door (lid opens at main wash).

view.doc: The cup in the open door faces up.

rinse_aid_reservoir.doc: Rinse-aid reservoir (0.12 L) with a level indicator; dispenses ~3 ml per cycle.

dishwasher_filter.doc: Cylindrical + flat mesh filter assembly; twist-lock in the sump. Clog = food/grease soil on it.

dishwasher_sump.doc: Sump under the filter where debris (bones, glass shards) collects.

dishwasher_pod.doc: Dishwasher detergent pod (one dose, ~16 g). Ingestion hazard for small children.

dishwasher_pod_tub.doc: Tub of dishwasher pods with a child-resistant lid. Keep closed and out of children's reach.

dishwasher_powder.doc: Dishwasher powder box (one dose fills the cup ~25 g).

rinse_aid_bottle.doc: Rinse aid (0.5 L) - for the rinse-aid reservoir only.

microwave.doc: Countertop microwave (1000 W output, 25 L, turntable). Door opening pauses it.

view.doc: A glass door with a perforated screen and a glass control panel: glossy (the display can glare), the cavity shows only while the light is on; the box itself is opaque.

microwave_otr.doc: Over-the-range microwave with a recirculating/vented fan, mounted ~1.5 m.

toaster.doc: Two-slot pop-up toaster (850 W). Slots 3.5 cm wide; shade 1-7; bagel/defrost modes; crumb tray.

toaster_oven.doc: Countertop toaster oven (1500 W, elements 3-4 cm above/below the rack, no auto-off on toast/bake).

view.doc: The glass door shows the racks; the box itself is opaque.

air_fryer.doc: Basket air fryer (1700 W, 4 L basket). Exhaust vents at the rear need ~13 cm clearance; never preheat loose parchment.

air_fryer_basket.doc: Removable nonstick air-fryer basket (cooking area 0.21 x 0.21 m, 4 L).

electric_kettle.doc: Cordless electric kettle (2.2 kW, MIN 0.5 L / MAX 1.7 L, auto-off, dry-boil protection). Heats only when seated on its powered base.

kettle_base.doc: Power base of a cordless kettle (keep dry; cord should not hang over the counter edge).

blender.doc: Countertop blender base (1000 W). The jar must be seated (interlock).

blender_jar.doc: 1.5 L blender jar with blade assembly; max 1.25 L cold, 0.6 L hot. Lid has a removable vent cap.

stand_mixer.doc: Tilt-head stand mixer (325 W, 4.7 L bowl, speeds 1-10). Change attachments only while off.

mixer_whisk.doc: Wire whip (cream, egg whites) - not for dough.

food_processor.doc: Food processor base (720 W) with interlock: bowl, blade on the post, lid locked.

processor_bowl.doc: 11-cup work bowl; liquids above the center-post line (0.5 L) leak.

processor_s_blade.doc: S-shaped chopping blade - hold it by the plastic hub.

processor_lid.doc: Lid with feed tube and pusher; twist to lock (interlock).

drip_coffee_maker.doc: 12-cup drip coffee maker (1.8 L reservoir, 900 W heater, 80 C warming plate with 2 h auto-off). The reservoir is the machine's own liquid.

coffee_filter_basket.doc: Swing-out brew basket of a drip coffee maker (holds a #4 paper filter and up to ~110 g grounds).

view.doc: Printed on the foil lid.

pod_coffee_machine.doc: Single-serve pod coffee machine (1.2 L reservoir; 240 ml per brew).

pod_holder.doc: Pod chamber of a pod machine.

espresso_machine.doc: Single-boiler espresso machine (9 bar, 2 L tank, steam wand).

portafilter.doc: 58 mm portafilter with an 18 g double basket.

knock_box.doc: Knock box for spent espresso pucks.

french_press.doc: 1 L glass French press (coarse grind, 4 min steep, then press).

milk_frother.doc: Electric milk frother (heats 115-240 ml to ~65 C).

waffle_maker.doc: Belgian waffle maker (1000 W, nonstick plates, ~180 ml batter per waffle, ready light).

electric_griddle.doc: Electric griddle (1500 W, 50 x 30 cm, 0.25 L grease trough).

stovetop_griddle.doc: Cast-iron reversible griddle for a gas range (spans two burners).

electric_pressure_cooker.doc: 6 qt electric pressure cooker (1000 W): lid locks while pressurized; min 0.25 L liquid; max 2/3 fill (1/2 for beans/grains).

pressure_cooker_pot.doc: Stainless inner pot (5.7 L): MAX line 3.8 L (2/3), half line 2.85 L.

sealing_ring.doc: Silicone sealing ring of a pressure-cooker lid.

slow_cooker.doc: 6 qt slow cooker base (LOW ~200 W, HIGH ~300 W, WARM). The stoneware insert is a separate part.

slow_cooker_insert.doc: Glazed stoneware insert (5.7 L) with glass lid. Thermal-shock limit ~60 K (cold insert into a hot base cracks).

rice_cooker.doc: 10-cup (1.8 L) rice cooker with a heavy body (600 W, 5.4 kg; with its pot about what an electric pressure cooker weighs, so the look-alikes feel and load the arm alike); cooks by water line, then keep-warm (limit ~12 h).

rice_cooker_pot.doc: Rice-cooker inner pot with water lines (white 1:1.25, brown 1:1.6 by volume over rice); thick multi-layer wall. Its label is the plain "inner pot" a pressure cooker's pot has too: a glance into an open cooker does not name the appliance.

bread_machine.doc: Bread machine with delay timer (programs 3-4 h).

gas_grill.doc: 3-burner propane grill (3 x 3.5 kW) with lid, igniter and a 20 lb tank. Keep >= 3 m from the house; never in a garage.

view.doc: The lid dial has 6 mm numerals.

charcoal_grill.doc: 57 cm kettle charcoal grill with lid and vents.

view.doc: The lid dial has 6 mm numerals.

propane_tank.doc: 20 lb (9 kg) propane cylinder with a handwheel valve. On a gas grill it is a part in the cart's tank holder (slot tank); close the valve before disconnecting it.

chimney_starter.doc: Charcoal chimney starter (lights ~2.5 kg of briquettes in ~15-20 min with newspaper).

lighter_fluid.doc: Charcoal lighter fluid (never onto lit coals).

view.doc: A kitchen timer's LCD digits are about 12 mm high.

oven_mitts.doc: Pair of quilted cotton oven mitts (rated ~250 C dry; a damp mitt conducts heat instantly).

props.label: oven mitts
props.home_hint: on the hook by the stove

view.doc: The heat rating is printed on the sewn-in label.

pot_holder.doc: Quilted pot holder (one hand, short contact only).

view.doc: The heat rating is printed on the sewn-in label.

instant_read_thermometer.doc: Instant-read probe thermometer (-40..300 C, +/-0.5 C, 3 s).

view.doc: An 8 mm LCD; the accuracy and range are fine print on the back.

oven_thermometer.doc: Dial oven thermometer that stands on a rack (+/-5 C).

view.doc: A 6-7 cm dial with 4 mm numerals: read from within about 0.4 m (or with the wrist camera).
A dial on a clip-on stem with 4 mm numerals.
A 6 cm dial with 4 mm numerals: read from within about 0.4 m (or with the wrist camera).

cake_tester.doc: Metal cake tester / skewer (insert in the centre: clean, moist crumbs or wet batter).
